description: This PHP source file defines the ModulesListForm class for Drupal, providing an interface for listing, filtering, and installing modules within the Drupal system. It includes methods for building the form, handling form submission, and managing module dependencies and compatibility.

classes.name: ModulesListForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class that provides an interface for listing, filtering, and installing modules, handling dependencies, and displaying module information.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as module handler, installer, key-value store, access manager, current user, permission handler, and extension list.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the module listing form with filters, module rows, and sorting.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Constructs a form row for each module, including info, links, and dependency checks.

methods.name: buildModuleList
methods.description: Generates a list of modules to install, including dependencies and non-stable modules, checking module requirements.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, processes module installation, and manages dependencies and errors.
